source_text: Ex eo quod scriptum est: et ego assumpsi Levitas de medio filiorum Israel pro omni primogenito qui adaperit vulvam et reliqua. Scriptum est de manna quia si quis id sumpsisset ut praeceperat Deus, nutriretur ex eo; si quis vero contra praeceptum Dei sumere voluisset, non frueretur eo ut vitali cibo, sed vermes ebullirent ex eo. Igitur et nostrum manna verbum Dei est: sermo Dei aliis efficitur ad salutem, aliis cedit ad poenam. Quanto melius esset nonnullis omnino nec audire verbum Dei quam audire cum malitia vel hypocrisi; vere autem melius est ut qui audit audiat corde bono et simplici, ut in terra bona fructificet. Haec in praefatione diximus propter catechumenos — et nonnullos baptizatos. Non enim omnes qui ex Israel hi sunt Israelitae, neque omnes qui loti sunt aqua continuo etiam Spiritu sancto loti sunt; e contrario non omnes catechumeni alieni sunt Spiritus sancti. Cornelius catechumenus ante aquas Spiritum meruit; Simon baptismum acceperat sed hypocrisi donum repudiavit. Nolo dubites et nunc esse Cornelios in catechumenis et Simones in fidelibus. Haec ad correptionem mei ipsius loquor; unus enim et ego sum ex his qui audiunt verbum Dei.
pass_a_gloss: From that which written-is: and I took Levites from midst of-sons of-Israel for every firstborn who opens womb and remaining-things. Written is concerning manna because if anyone it had-taken as had-commanded God, would-be-nourished from it; if anyone however against precept of-God to-take had-wished, not would-enjoy it as living food, but worms would-boil-out from it. Therefore also our manna word of-God is: speech of-God for-some is-made unto salvation, for-others yields unto punishment. How-much better it-would-be for-some altogether not to-hear word of-God than to-hear with malice or hypocrisy; truly however better is that who hears hear with-heart good and simple, that in earth good it-may-bear-fruit. These-things in preface we-said because-of catechumens — and some baptized. For not all who from Israel these are Israelites, nor all who washed are with-water immediately also with-Spirit holy washed are; on-the-contrary not all catechumens strangers are of-Spirit holy. Cornelius catechumen before waters Spirit merited; Simon baptism had-received but by-hypocrisy gift repudiated. I-am-unwilling you-doubt also now to-be Corneliuses among catechumens and Simons among faithful. These to correction of-myself I-speak; one for also I am from these who hear word of-God.
pass_b_english: From what is written — [[I have taken the Levites from the midst of the children of Israel in place of every firstborn who opens the womb >> Bible:Numbers 3:12]] — and the rest. Scripture says of the manna that whoever took it as God commanded was nourished by it; whoever took it against the divine measure did not enjoy it as living food, but [[worms swarmed out of it >> Bible:Exodus 16:20]]. So our manna is the word of God: the same sermon becomes salvation for some and punishment for others. How much better for some never to hear the word than to hear it with malice or hypocrisy — though truly better still is to hear with a good and simple heart, that it may [[bear fruit in good soil >> Bible:Luke 8:15]]. We say this in preface for catechumens — and for some of the baptized. [[Not all who are of Israel are Israel >> Bible:Romans 9:6]]; not all washed with water are at once washed with the Holy Spirit; and not every catechumen is a stranger to the Spirit. [[Cornelius >> Bible:Acts 10:44-47]] received the Spirit before the water; [[Simon >> Bible:Acts 8:13-21]] had baptism yet lost the gift by hypocrisy. Do not doubt that Corneliuses still stand among catechumens and Simons among the faithful. I say this to correct myself; I too am one of those who hear the word of God.
notes: Homilia II §§1–2 batch (not full Homilia CLOSEOUT; §§3+ ahead).
